KPI_1.name: Opportunity Count for EMEA Teams
KPI_1.description: Total count of opportunities for EMEA regional teams, providing visibility into pipeline volume across European markets.

KPI_2.name: Total Opportunity ACV
KPI_2.description: Total Annual Contract Value of opportunities, representing the primary revenue metric for sales performance.

KPI_3.name: Opportunity Name Count for Unassigned Opportunities
KPI_3.description: Count of opportunities that do not have a Sales Engineer assigned, indicating resource allocation gaps.

KPI_4.name: Total Opportunity Booked ACV
KPI_4.description: Total Annual Contract Value of closed won opportunities, representing actual revenue generated.

KPI_5.name: Total Opportunity TCV for EMEA Teams
KPI_5.description: Total Contract Value for EMEA regional teams, measuring the complete deal value including multi-year contracts.

KPI_6.name: Total Field Opportunity ACV
KPI_6.description: Total Annual Contract Value from field operations perspective for closed won opportunities.

KPI_7.name: Opportunity S2 To S7 Conversion Rate for New Customers
KPI_7.description: Conversion rate from S2 stage to closed won for new customer opportunities, measuring sales effectiveness.

KPI_8.name: Total Activity Hours for EMEA SEs
KPI_8.description: Total hours logged by Sales Engineers in EMEA region, measuring resource utilization and capacity.

KPI_9.name: Person MQLs Count for EMEA Regions
KPI_9.description: Marketing Qualified Leads count across EMEA regions, indicating top-of-funnel marketing performance.

KPI_10.name: Vivun Deliverables Count for PoV Win Rate
KPI_10.description: Count of completed Proof of Value deliverables, measuring pre-sales technical engagement success.

attributes: Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Owner Team, Opportunity SE Name, Opportunity Owner Name, Opportunity Type
goal: Track and optimize sales opportunity pipeline management to drive revenue growth and improve sales team performance across the EMEA region.
user_context: Sales operations managers and presales leaders use this dashboard during weekly and monthly sales management meetings to comprehensively monitor and optimize EMEA sales performance across the entire opportunity lifecycle from lead generation through deal closure, systematically analyzing opportunity hygiene by identifying unassigned opportunities at different stages (M0/M1 unassigned, S1 discovery opportunities without SEs, renewal opportunities lacking SE assignment), tracking pipeline progression by examining conversion rates from S2 to S7 stages with particular focus on new customer deals and proof-of-value outcomes, evaluating SE allocation and performance by monitoring workload distribution across sales engineers, measuring their contribution to closed deals, and analyzing activity hours against opportunity counts, assessing pipeline health by reviewing opportunities with past-due close dates, deals stuck in stages for extended periods, and quarterly cohort analysis of deal progression, monitoring lead generation effectiveness by analyzing MQL trends by cloud data warehouse type and regional performance, and measuring presales effectiveness through PoV win rates, successful trial conversions, and deal velocity metrics, while paying special attention to EMEA-specific regional performance patterns, renewal opportunity management, and the critical need to ensure proper SE assignment to maintain deal progression velocity and avoid pipeline stagnation.
